query:
UPDATE "Wallet"
              SET "name" = COALESCE(?1, "name"),
                  "managementUrl" = CASE WHEN ?2 THEN ?3 ELSE "managementUrl" END,
                  "custodyType" = COALESCE(?4, "custodyType"),
                  "storageType" = CASE WHEN ?5 THEN ?6 ELSE "storageType" END,
                  "updatedAt" = ?7
            WHERE "id" = ?8
